name: Acting
description: Players must perform or mime clues for other players.

name: Action Points
description: Players receive a limited number of action points each turn to spend on various actions.

name: Area Control / Area Influence
description: Players compete to control regions of the board for points or benefits.

name: Area Majority
description: Influence is scored proportionally based on the amount of presence in an area.

name: Auction/Bidding
description: Players bid resources to acquire items, actions, or turn order.

name: Card Drafting
description: Players pick cards from a shared pool to build their hand or tableau.

name: Cooperative Game
description: Players work together against the game system to achieve a common goal.

name: Deck Building
description: Players start with a small deck and acquire cards to improve it over the game.

name: Dice Rolling
description: Dice are rolled to determine outcomes or generate resources.

name: Drafting
description: Players select items from a set before passing the remainder to opponents.

name: Engine Building
description: Players construct combinations of abilities that generate increasingly powerful effects.

name: Hand Management
description: The strategic use and timing of cards held by a player.

name: Hidden Movement
description: One or more players move pieces secretly while others try to deduce their location.

name: Hidden Roles
description: Players have secret identities that affect their objectives and allegiances.

name: Modular Board
description: The board is composed of tiles or pieces that vary from game to game.

name: Pattern Building
description: Players arrange components to form specific shapes or patterns.

name: Push Your Luck
description: Players repeatedly risk accumulated gains for the chance of greater rewards.

name: Role Playing
description: Players assume characters and make decisions from their perspective.

name: Route Building
description: Players create networks of roads, rails, or connections between locations.

name: Set Collection
description: Players gather groups of related items to score points or unlock abilities.

name: Simultaneous Action Selection
description: Players choose actions privately and reveal them at the same time.

name: Solo / Solitaire Game
description: The game can be played by a single player against automated systems or scenarios.

name: Storytelling
description: Narrative creation and shared fiction are central to gameplay.

name: Tile Placement
description: Players place tiles onto the board, often forming a growing landscape.

name: Worker Placement
description: Players place worker tokens on board spaces to claim actions or resources.
